name: io.github.tazwaryayyyy/memoire-mcp
title: Memoire
description: Local-first semantic memory for coding agents: SQLite + local embeddings, no hosted service.

environmentVariables.name: MEMOIRE_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the SQLite memory database. If unset the server uses <workspace>/.memoire_path or <workspace>/memoire.db.

environmentVariables.name: FASTEMBED_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the embedding model (about 87 MiB, downloaded on first use). Set one shared directory to avoid a download per working directory.

environmentVariables.name: MEMOIRE_TRIAL_CAP
environmentVariables.description: Maximum unverified (no-feedback) memories one recall returns. Non-negative integer; the engine default is 1.

environmentVariables.name: MEMOIRE_ENABLE_ADMIN_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose memoire_clear and memoire_import. Off by default; leave off unless you need them.
